about_the_game:
Dive into the Rift. Hoard riches. Become a legend.

Plunge into collapsing dimensions in Rift Miner, a unique 3D voxel roguelite. Mine valuable resources against the clock, return to the hub with your haul, and invest in powerful permanent upgrades. Every venture is different—what treasures will you extract from the depths before time runs out?

About this game

DIG. UPGRADE. SURVIVE. REPEAT.

In Rift Miner, every dive into the Rift is a fresh, high-stakes run. Enter shifting, fully destructible voxel worlds whose handcrafted structures are filled with procedurally distributed ores. Your goal: extract as many resources as possible and escape through the portal before the timer hits zero.

No two runs are the same. Discover powerful Echo Cards that grant game-changing bonuses for a single run. Combine cards to create incredible synergies: unleash automated drone swarms to farm for you, trigger seismic shockwaves that clear entire caverns, or overcharge your pickaxe with kinetic energy to shatter whole pillars of rock in a single swing.

Back in the safety of the hub, your progress is permanent. Use your spoils to permanently upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, customize the shape of your drill head, and even research new Rift types. Every purchase makes you stronger, letting you push into deeper, richer, and more dangerous worlds.

Ready to test your luck? For the boldest miners, there are the high-risk "Deeper Rifts": a chain of worlds with a fixed timer where you’ll find no additional Echo Cards—but earn massive bonuses for every loop survived. One mistake, and the entire haul from the chain is lost.

How deep will you dare to dig?

Features

  • Satisfying roguelite loop: No run is the same. The perfect mix of permanent progression and run-based builds.

  • Fully destructible 3D voxel worlds: Carve your own path through diverse, handcrafted mines that are freshly repopulated with ores on every visit.

  • Deep permanent upgrade system: Invest in dozens of upgrades to permanently improve your tools, abilities, and odds of survival.

  • Synergies via over 32 Echo Cards: Discover and combine cards to create unique, overpowered builds for every run.

  • Unleash drone swarms: Find powerful Echo Cards to activate automated drones that mine independently and maximize your efficiency.

  • Customizable drill: Shape your drill head on a 3x3 grid to optimize your mining strategy.

  • High-risk endgame "Deeper Rifts": Face the ultimate "Push Your Luck" challenge for massive rewards.

  • Leaderboards: Compete with other players to see who survives the deepest Deeper Rifts loop and gathers the most resources.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 or equivalent (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
